title: Borneo Half Marathon 2027 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Borneo Half Marathon 2027 Review | Kota Kinabalu, Sabah
meta_description: Borneo Half Marathon review: 4,000+ runners from 7 countries at Padang Merdeka on 8 February 2026, a City Day race. What changes for 31 January 2027.
dek: Kota Kinabalu's City Day half marathon drew more than 4,000 runners to Padang Merdeka in February 2026. Here is what that edition was like, and what changes for the 2027 race on 31 January.
verdict: The Borneo Half Marathon is Kota Kinabalu's civic race, run with the city council for City Day. The 2026 edition, on 8 February, drew more than 4,000 runners, including runners from seven countries, to Padang Merdeka in the city centre [3]. It was flagged off at 5.30am, with a 21 km and an 11 km and age-group categories plus an Intercity Mayor's Cup [3]. For 2027 the race moves to Sunday 31 January, the half marathon starts an hour earlier at 4.30am, and the shorter race becomes a 10.5 km [2]. If you want a well-supported 21 km in Sabah in the city centre, it is a good choice.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: The 2026 Borneo Half Marathon was held on 8 February at Padang Merdeka, Kota Kinabalu, as part of the city's 26th City Day celebrations, and drew more than 4,000 participants [3]. It is co-organised by Kota Kinabalu City Hall (DBKK) and the Kinabalu Running Club [3].

Runners came from seven other countries, the UK, Hong Kong, Brunei, Singapore, the Philippines, the United States and Italy, as well as from across Malaysia [3]. The flag-off at 5.30am was attended by the state minister responsible for the city hall and the mayor [3].

sections.heading: Distances and Categories
paragraphs: The 2026 race had a 21 km and an 11 km, each with open, junior veteran, veteran and senior veteran categories for men and women, and an Intercity Mayor's Cup [3].
It is a separate race from the Borneo International Marathon, which the same club runs in Kota Kinabalu in May and which includes the full marathon [4].

sections.heading: What Changes for 2027
paragraphs: The 2027 race is on Sunday 31 January, eight days earlier in the calendar than 2026, and still starts from Padang Merdeka [1][2]. The half marathon goes at 4.30am and the shorter race, now 10.5 km, at 5.30am [2]. That is an hour earlier for the half marathon than in 2026 [2][3], which helps in a city a few degrees north of the equator.
Race pack collection is scheduled for 29 and 30 January 2027 [2]. Entry fees had not been published on the registration listing when this review was written [2].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a 21 km in East Malaysia with a city-centre start and finish and an experienced organiser. The field of more than 4,000 gives it atmosphere without being unmanageable.
Plan for the earlier start: a 4.30am gun means an early night, and the pack collection is on the Friday and Saturday before, so arrive by Friday if you are flying in.
This review is compiled from the city council's report on the 2026 edition and the organisers' published 2027 information. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Borneo Half Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: More than 4,000 participants took part on 8 February 2026 at Padang Merdeka, Kota Kinabalu, including runners from seven other countries. The race was held as part of Kota Kinabalu's 26th City Day celebrations.

faqs.question: What changes for the 2027 Borneo Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The date moves to Sunday 31 January 2027, the half marathon starts an hour earlier at 4.30am, and the shorter race becomes a 10.5 km, where 2026 had an 11 km. The start and finish stay at Padang Merdeka.

faqs.question: Is the Borneo Half Marathon the same as the Borneo International Marathon?
faqs.answer: No. Both are run by the Kinabalu Running Club in Kota Kinabalu, but the Borneo Half Marathon, co-organised with the city hall, is held in January or February, and the Borneo International Marathon, with the full marathon, is held in May.
